strings.step_aside_join: {0} is installed: Beacon does not change joining. Open the Beacon panel to import its servers.
strings.storage_session: Passwords: remembered until the game closes (no usable keyring)
strings.secret_store_failed: Beacon could not use the system keyring; the password was not saved.
strings.secret_stored_elsewhere: The password for {0} was stored on another computer or user account. Enter it again.
strings.autojoin_countdown: Joining {0} in {1} s. Press Escape or B to cancel.
strings.autojoin_unknown_server: Automatic join: no saved server named {0}.
strings.reconnect_locked: This server turned off automatic reconnect.
strings.favorite_removed: {0} was removed from Beacon. Use Undo to keep it.
strings.import_none: No AutoConnector server list was found.
strings.import_password_not_stored: {0} was imported without its password; it could not be stored safely.
strings.import_source_plain: AutoConnector's servers.yaml still holds the passwords in plain text.
strings.import_blank_done: Removed {0} plain-text passwords from AutoConnector's servers.yaml.
strings.cmd_help: beacon status | beacon join <name> | beacon cancel | beacon import preview | beacon import apply | beacon import blank-source confirm
strings.cmd_usage: Usage: beacon status | join <name> | cancel | import preview | import apply | import blank-source confirm
strings.cmd_confirm_blank: This removes every password from AutoConnector's servers.yaml and keeps no copy. Run again with 'confirm' to proceed.
strings.cmd_join_not_ready: Beacon can join a server only from the main menu with a character.
strings.card_cancel_hint: Cancel: Escape, pad B or the console command 'beacon cancel'.
strings.ui_password_hint: Leave password empty to keep the current password. Use Forget password to remove it.
strings.ui_empty: No saved servers. Add one to begin.
strings.ui_read_only: The saved server file could not be read. It is preserved; editing is disabled.
strings.ui_step_aside: Another join mod is active; Beacon joining is unavailable.
strings.ui_write_failed: The server file could not be saved. No server details were changed.
strings.ui_invalid: Check the name and addresses. Names and addresses must be unique.
strings.ui_forget_all_confirm: Forget every password saved by Beacon?
strings.import_preview_again: Preview the current import again before applying it.
strings.import_write_failed: Beacon could not save its server list. No passwords were imported.
strings.import_password_pending: Passwords are being imported into protected storage.
strings.ui_import_blank_confirm: Remove every password from AutoConnector's servers.yaml? No backup or copy of those passwords will be kept.
strings.ui_undo_conflict: The server could not be restored. Check for a newer server with the same name or address, or a file write failure.
strings.ui_favorite_save_failed: The game could not save its favorites list. Its save restrictions remain in effect.
strings.ui_help_previous: Select the previous saved server without joining it.
strings.ui_help_next: Select the next saved server without joining it.
strings.ui_help_add: Open a new server entry. Nothing is saved until you choose Save.
strings.ui_help_edit: Edit the selected server name, address, aliases or stored password.
strings.ui_help_join: Join the selected server through Valheim's normal connection flow. Existing access restrictions still apply.
strings.ui_help_remove: Remove the selected saved server entry after confirmation.
strings.ui_help_up: Move the selected server up in your saved list.
strings.ui_help_down: Move the selected server down in your saved list.
strings.ui_help_default: Set the selected server as default, or clear its default status if already selected.
strings.ui_help_forget: Remove the selected server password from protected storage after confirmation. Keep the server entry.
strings.ui_help_forget_all: Remove all saved server passwords from protected storage after confirmation. Keep the server entries.
strings.ui_help_import: Preview AutoConnector's server list and password import. Opening the preview changes nothing.
strings.ui_help_select: Select this saved server. Selection alone does not connect.
strings.ui_help_cancel: Cancel this action without applying unsaved changes.
strings.ui_help_save: Save this server entry. An empty password keeps the current stored password.
strings.ui_help_name: A name for this saved server. Use a distinct name in your server list.
strings.ui_help_address: The server address and port, or a supported hosted-game address.
strings.ui_help_aliases: Optional alternate addresses, separated by commas, for recognizing this same server.
strings.ui_help_save_password: Save the entered server password using Beacon's configured secret storage.
strings.ui_help_undo: Restore the recently removed favorite if no newer server entry conflicts with it.
strings.ui_help_import_apply: Apply the reviewed server import and store available passwords through the configured secret storage.
strings.ui_help_servers: Manage saved servers, aliases and protected passwords. Opening Beacon does not join a server.
strings.cfg_general__add_to_favorites_help: Adds every saved server to the Favorite tab of the Join Game screen.
strings.cfg_general__skip_password_prompt_help: Sends a saved server's stored password when the game asks for it, so the prompt is not shown.
strings.cfg_general__offer_to_save_passwords_hel: After a server accepts a password you typed, asks once per server whether Beacon should save it.
strings.cfg_general__remove_entry_with_favorite_: Removing a saved server from the game's favorites also removes it from Beacon (with an undo message).
strings.cfg_general__panel_key_help: Keyboard shortcut that opens the Beacon panel. Empty: only the Join Game screen button opens it.
strings.cfg_auto_join__auto_join_help: Joins a saved server automatically after the game reaches the main menu, after a short countdown you can cancel.
strings.cfg_auto_join__auto_join_server_help: Name of the saved server to join. Empty: the server marked as default.
strings.cfg_auto_join__auto_join_character_help: Character to join with. Empty: the last character used.
strings.cfg_auto_join__auto_join_countdown_secon: Seconds of countdown before the automatic join; Escape or the pad's B button cancels.
strings.cfg_reconnect__reconnect_on_disconnect_h: Reconnects after an unexpected disconnect. Never after a kick or ban. A server running Beacon may turn this off.
strings.cfg_reconnect__reconnect_attempts_help: Most reconnect attempts after one disconnect.
strings.cfg_passwords__linux_fallback_help: On Linux without a usable keyring: SessionOnly remembers passwords until the game closes; Disabled never stores them. On Linux a change applies right away. On systems other than Windows and Linux, restart the game after changing it.
strings.cfg_server__allow_automatic_reconnect_he: Server policy: false prevents Beacon clients from automatically reconnecting after an unexpected disconnect. True leaves each player's preference unchanged.
